facts: Neocaridina shrimp molt every few weeks. They eat the old shell to recover calcium.
A berried female carries 20 to 40 eggs under her tail and fans them for about a month.
Colour morphs like Cherry, Blue Dream and Black Rose are all the same species: Neocaridina davidi.
Shrimp are mostly eating biofilm, the invisible layer of microbes on every surface.
A big water change can trigger a tank-wide molting wave.
Males are smaller and paler than females. The females get the good colour.
Low GH means shrimp can't build a proper shell. Failed molts follow.
Bladder snails arrive as hitchhikers on plants. There is never just one.
Shrimp have personalities. Some will graze under bright light. Some never leave the moss.
Mixing colour morphs tends to produce wild-type brown offspring after a few generations.
Nerite snails can't breed in freshwater, but they will lay stubborn white eggs everywhere.
Indian almond leaves release tannins, lower pH slightly and grow a lovely biofilm.
